# Absolute Soccer - Mississauga Soccer Store

> Absolute Soccer (formerly Golazo Store) is Mississauga's premier local soccer specialty store. We carry Nike, Adidas, Puma, Joma, and New Balance soccer cleats, jerseys, goalkeeper gloves, training gear, and team apparel. We offer custom kit printing, name & number lettering, and full team uniform packages for soccer clubs throughout Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Toronto, Etobicoke, Milton, and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA).

## About

- **Also known as:** Toronto Soccer Shop, Golazo Store (former name)
- **Location:** Mississauga, Ontario, Canada
- **Phone:** 905-593-3600
- **Website:** https://torontosoccershop.com
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/absolutemississauga

## Store Hours

- Monday to Friday: 1:00 PM - 7:00 PM
- Saturday and Sunday: 11:00 AM - 4:00 PM

## Products We Carry

- **Soccer Cleats:** Firm ground, soft ground, turf, indoor soccer shoes from Nike, Adidas, Puma, Joma, New Balance; adult and youth sizes
- **Jerseys:** Official national team jerseys, club jerseys, replica and authentic kits
- **Goalkeeper Gloves:** Sizes 3-11 for youth and adult goalkeepers
- **Soccer Balls:** Sizes 1-5 for training and match play
- **Training Apparel:** Training shorts, tops, bibs, compression gear
- **Accessories:** Soccer bags, shin guards, socks, captain armbands, water bottles
- **Custom Kits:** Team jersey printing with names, numbers, crests and sponsor logos

## Services

- In-store pickup with same-day fitting assistance
- Custom kit printing and name & number lettering
- Official club kit supply for local soccer leagues
- Team uniform packages for Mississauga Soccer League, youth academies and recreational clubs
- Custom business apparel: t-shirts, polos, hoodies, embroidery, screen printing, workwear

## Brands We Carry

Nike, Adidas, Puma, Joma, New Balance, Umbro, Reusch (goalkeeper gloves)

## Geographic Service Area

Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Toronto, Etobicoke, Milton, Burlington, Hamilton, Scarborough, North York, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Markham — Greater Toronto Area (GTA) and southern Ontario
